newsitem.title: INDIA: India agrees to promote investment in roads -daily.
newsitem.headline: India agrees to promote investment in roads -daily.

text.p: The Indian government has approved a package of incentives to promote private investment in roads, the Economic Times said on Thursday.
The business daily said the Cabinet Committee on Infrastructure had agreed to remove the import duty on road construction equipment and to grant township ownership rights to road developers.

The committee agreed that real estate income which is ploughed back into road development will be exempt from tax, and the government will invest in road projects which cannot be supported by toll revenues alone, it said.
Surface Transport Minister T.G. Venkatraman was expected to unveil the package at a news conference set for Thursday at 11:30 a.m. (0600 GMT).
